income_notes: It is the user's responsibility to know the purpose for which the F&RL percentage will be used so that the most appropriate percentage is obtained.  Different F&RL percentages may be found on various DESE web pages.  The percentages displayed on one page may vary from the percentages found on another page due to the various purposes for which these data are collected and used as well as different comparisons made.

The data presented on this page are the F&RL percentages for each public school building by school district.  These "building level" data only include those students educated in the building.  The counts do not include Deseg Out students for the St. Louis County districts or the St. Louis City school district nor do they include students in grades 9-12 otherwise counted in a K-8 (Elementary) district.

The percentage on this web page is calculated by dividing the number of students eligible for free or reduced price lunch on the last Wednesday of January by the January membership reported in Core Data.  The data used in this calculation were submitted by each district in the February Core Data Cycle.

Some buildings are marked as a Community Eligibility Provision (CEP) participanting building.  The Community Eligibility Provision (CEP) provides the option to offer free meals to all students in eligible high poverty Local Education Agencies (LEA) and schools without collecting household applications.  All students in these buildings are reported as free lunch.
